entries.en: I met up with Haru at the aquarium...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We have a large fish tank at work, too...[n]but there's a different sort of beauty to[n]all this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've seen a few aquarium dates in[n]romance movies. It always seemed[n]like such a lovely outing.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: At the time, a normal relationship[n]seemed beyond my means. I'd given[n]up on ever experiencing it myself...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I suppose this means you've made[n]another of my dreams come true.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Was all this an attempt to return my[n]affections from Valentine's Day?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wasn't really expecting anything in[n]return, but... I'm happy you did all this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Did you ask me out because it's[n]White Day?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I see! Thank goodness...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We had to spend Valentine's Day apart,[n]so... I was worried about us.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But once I got your invite, all that[n]melted away.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I don't suppose this is intended as a date[n]for White Day?
Of course.
Yes.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This doesn't have to be some kind of[n]penance for you, you know.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And you asked me out today, so...[n]the past is past.
Haru seems pleased...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I suppose we've seen everything by now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, we do have some time left...[n]Shall we get something to eat before[n]we go home?
I already have a reservation set.
I have a place in mind.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What? Oh, thank you...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: In that case, lead the way.
